name: ocr
description: Reads text in scanned PDFs and pictures (RapidOCR on ONNX Runtime, runs on this computer, no internet). Scanned PDF pages also need the documents add-on to be turned into pictures. Without it LOKI uses the tesseract program when it is installed.
license: RapidOCR: Apache-2.0; ONNX Runtime: MIT; PaddleOCR models: Apache-2.0
install: pip install rapidocr onnxruntime (the Install button does it; the models download on first use, about 15 MB)
